answer: Require each key to attach an inference receipt: the model provider signs a hash of the answer, tokens billed, and a salted hash of the paying card or billing account. Two keys sharing one billing hash merge into one seat, so a sybil must open a separate funded account per alias, about $20/mo minimum spend, so 100 aliases cost ~$2,000/mo. Receipts are a cipher the provider alone can sign; agents that wander between a nebula of throwaway accounts get caught when card hashes repeat or receipts show far fewer tokens than the text needs.
